 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    points.sort()
    (r0, c0), (r1, c1) = points[0], points[1]
    dr, dc = r1 - r0, c1 - c0
    if dr == 0 or dc == 0:
        return out
    # Continue the regularly spaced diagonal sequence, marking extrapolated cells in color 2.
    r, c = points[-1]
    while 0 <= r + dr < len(out) and 0 <= c + dc < len(out[0]):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
